name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.4: customers who leave an email now get an acknowledgement. The kiosk tells the customer we will reply by email, but nothing was ever sent automatically — customerEmail was stored only for a manual operator reply, so the promise went unkept. Both the coil and fridge complaint paths now send a short Icelandic acknowledgement when an address is supplied, naming the machine and the reported reason and making no promise about timing or outcome; the operators real reply still follows separately. Sending is best effort and never blocks the complaint, and a failure raises the email-delivery-failing alert. Cumulative over v6.3.
